settings.title: What Are SD-WAN And Network Design Services?

settings.editor: Network design defines how devices, offices, users, internet connections, data centers, and applications communicate securely.
SD-WAN, or software-defined wide area networking, adds centralized control across multiple connections such as broadband, fiber, MPLS, and cellular links.
Together, network design and SD-WAN can help businesses:
Route traffic based on business priorities
Reduce dependence on a single carrier
Voice, video, ERP, and collaboration traffic can receive priority over less important traffic.
Traffic can move between links based on latency, packet loss, availability, and policy.
Automated failover helps maintain connectivity when a connection becomes unavailable.
IT teams can review connection status, traffic, and performance from a central platform.
Network and security policies can be applied consistently across several locations
Standardized designs make it easier to connect new offices, users, and applications.
